build_vanillamodel: build a VanillaModel with input_dim, output_dim, encoder_dim, decoder_dim, estimator_dim, denoiser_dim, codebook_channels, codebook_classes, and dropout parameters
build_motionmodel: build a MotionModel with sequence_length, input_dim, output_dim, encoder_dim, decoder_dim, estimator_dim, denoiser_dim, codebook_channels, codebook_classes, and dropout parameters
run_model_forward: run the Model forward pass by calling model(x, iterations=1, sample=False) to sample codes through the Sampler then decode via the Prior
run_model_learn: run the Model learn method with input, output, and update_statistics to compute reconstruction, matching, and denoising losses
run_prior_reconstruct: run the Prior reconstruct method with features and sample flag to encode, quantize through codebook, and decode back to feature space
